item.title: My Fair Link - Yousei Byakuya Monogatari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Light Plan
  • 発売日: 2000-02-25
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Myフェアりんく 妖精白夜物語
  • 英語名: My Fair Link - Yousei Byakuya Monogatari

あらすじ

One day hero finds a fairy falling unconscious in the forest. He takes her home. Fairy tells her story that she fell in love with a human and now wishes to gain a human form with magic. Hero wishes to cooperate and supply magical powers by providing sexual magic. This way their unusual cohabitation begins.

item.title: Shanghai Maid Monogatari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Light Plan
  • 発売日: 1999-06-11
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 上海侍女物語
  • 英語名: Shanghai Maid Monogatari

别名

  • Shanghai Maid Story

あらすじ

Our guy’s father’s will orders him to train 5 maids under his secretary’s supervision. He has to work them day and night. All 5 maids love him, but will he be able to forget his lost lover (a maid shot in a street riot) and love them back?

[Edited from Li’s Fun House]
